blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Health (DOH) Metro Manila Center for Health Development (MMCHD) has raised its alert status to code blue ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. The DOH-MMCHD on Saturday said that the heightened alert status will take effect from Nov. 10 to 20 to ensure the readiness of the hospital at the upcoming regional meeting. Under Code Blue alert, all of its personnel, retained hospitals, and treatment and rehabilitation centers were directed to remain vigilant and closely monitor summit-related developments.
